Mozilla CA certificate bundle distributed by curl.
https://curl.se/docs/caextract.html
https://curl.se/docs/caextract.html#license
https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
The complete unmodified PEM, including its upstream header, is in
../curl-ca-bundle.crt and in the source pack's _packages/cacert.pem.
The bundle is a conversion of Mozilla's certificate store, not original
Retro Weather content. Certificate metadata retains its upstream terms.
